name: Cutscene camera
description: A camera shot: when something calls its id (a door lock light's cutscene when its door unlocks, a target switch, a night-vision pad), player 1's camera holds here, looking the way it faces, for its duration, then returns. The first one in the list with that id plays; give every shot its own id, not 0. MSR 'Cutscene camera'.

fields.name: pitch
fields.description: up and down: positive looks up (the game's shots look a little down: -1052 to -3425)

fields.name: duration
fields.description: how long the shot holds, in 60 Hz frames (the game's: 121, 181, 301)

fields.name: id
fields.description: the number a door lock light's cutscene (and other callers) plays it by; 0 = never
